generation_parameters.prompt: Create a transparent 6-column x 2-row orthographic pixel-art atlas. Columns exactly front, top, right, left, bottom, rear. Rows exactly dining-table, kitchen-stove matching supplied references. One complete centered object in each cell. Preserve object identity, source proportions, material, palette, decoration. True orthographic directions, top straight down, bottom underside, rear opposite front; infer hidden sides. No scenery, floor, shadow, perspective, text, labels, borders, or cell marks. Crisp game pixel art, transparent background.
